maxSnapsPerUser.description: Maximum number of story snaps to extract per user across all their highlights.
maxSnapsPerUser.title: Max Snaps Per User

postedAfter.description: Only return snaps posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Many creators' curated highlights stay live for months or years, so re-running without this filter re-collects the same old content every time — set it to your last run's date to fetch only new snaps. Leave empty to collect all available snaps (default).
postedAfter.title: Posted After

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Public Snapchat profiles work without proxy; include for resilience.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

sources.description: Which story sources to extract. curatedHighlights = saved highlight albums. activeStory = current public ephemeral story snaps.
sources.title: Story Sources

usernames.description: One or more Snapchat usernames or profile URLs. Accepted formats: bare username (djkhaled), @-prefixed (@djkhaled), add URL (https://www.snapchat.com/add/djkhaled), or profile URL (https://www.snapchat.com/@djkhaled).
usernames.title: Usernames or Profile URLs
